mechanism: Cross-sensitivity and potential cross-reactivity between beta-lactam antibiotics due to shared beta-lactam ring structure, with risk of allergic reactions in penicillin-sensitized patients.
action: Avoid concurrent use in patients with documented penicillin allergy; if cephalosporin necessary, use with caution and appropriate monitoring as cephalosporins have 1-3% cross-reactivity with penicillins, particularly first-generation cephalosporins like cefazolin.
